commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' 3 - 0 Endrick (Real Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Karl Hein is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
90+4' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90+4' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valladolid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+2' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' A pass from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Karl Hein and the move breaks down.
88' 2 - 0 Goal! Eder Militao gets to the ball, slips Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
86' Here is a change. Kylian Mbappe is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Endrick (Real Madrid).
86' A fine solo run by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
85' The game has come to an end for Vinicius Junior. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
85' Paulo Pezzolano decides to make a substitution. Kike Perez will be replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid).

84' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Valladolid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
82' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
82' Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
80' Karl Hein pulls off a great save to deny Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
79' The referee signals a corner kick to Valladolid.
75' The referee blows for a cooling break.
75' The foul by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
74' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
71' Substitution. Stanko Juric will be replaced by Mario Martin (Valladolid).
71' Substitution. Marcos Andre walks off the pitch and Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) comes on as a substitute.
70' Raul Moro (Valladolid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
69' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Arda Guler and he is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Rodrygo as he is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
66' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it.
63' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Karl Hein, who pulls off a stunning save!
61' Real Madrid keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
59' CHANCE! Raul Moro (Valladolid) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
59' Substitution. Selim Amallah (Valladolid) replaces Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas.
58' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul Moro (Valladolid) replacing Darwin Machis.
58' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
58' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick, but Karl Hein reads it well and stops the effort.
57' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
57' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
52' Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Thibaut Courtois keeps it out with an amazing save.
52' The referee shows the yellow card to Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
52' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) shoots from distance and his effort takes a nick off the defender and goes past Karl Hein. 1:0.
50' The free kick is taken short by Real Madrid.
48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Karl Hein easily makes the save.
47' Good clearance! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

45+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
45+2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) and Kylian Mbappe combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
43' Handball! A player from Real Madrid handled the ball.

39' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
39' Flavien Boyomo (Valladolid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Victor Garcia blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
35' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
32' A cooling break is underway.
32' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid). A free kick has been awarded to Valladolid.
29' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kike Perez (Valladolid).
28' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
28' Arda Guler receives a short pass from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:1. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
26' Real Madrid are ruled offside.

24' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
22' Karl Hein (Valladolid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' Karl Hein (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Victor Garcia blows his whistle as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.
17' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post.
16' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
14' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
13' Kike Perez (Valladolid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
11' A clumsy foul by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) and Victor Garcia blows his whistle.

10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Karl Hein with a brilliant diving save!

9' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
8' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
6' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' A crossfield pass from Eder Militao (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
3' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
2' Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. That's a free kick to Real Madrid.
1' The match has just started.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Victor Garcia.
